questions.question: Which of the following is acceptable during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Front tire tread of 3/32 of an inch

questions.explanation: Front tires must have at least 4/32 of an inch of tread depth. Other tires must have at least 2/32 of an inch of tread depth. All tires on a vehicle must be the same size.

questions.question: A skid caused by pressing the accelerator too hard can usually be stopped by:
questions.explanation: Release the accelerator to stop a skid caused by pressing it too hard. This type of skid happens most often on snow or ice.

questions.question: An encroachment is:

options.text: When a driver does not show up for their basic skills test.
When a vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
When a driver fails one part of the basic skills test.

questions.correctAnswerText: When a vehicle touches a boundary line during the basic skills test.
questions.explanation: An encroachment happens when your vehicle touches or crosses a boundary line during the basic skills test. Each encroachment counts as an error.

questions.question: When driving in wet conditions, a lack of spray from other vehicles' tires means:

options.text: Ice has formed on the road.
The spray is trapped under the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice has formed on the road.
questions.explanation: If you see no spray from other vehicles in wet conditions, ice has formed on the road. Drive slowly and carefully in wet, freezing conditions.

questions.question: Backing with a trailer is dangerous because:

options.text: It is hard to see what is behind the vehicle.
Most trucks cannot go in reverse.
Cargo may fall out of the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is hard to see what is behind the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Backing is always dangerous because you cannot see everything behind you. Only drive in reverse if absolutely necessary.

questions.question: Class 1 hazardous material is:
questions.explanation: Class 1 hazardous materials are explosives. Examples include ammunition, dynamite, and fireworks.

questions.question: A broken exhaust system:

options.text: Can allow poisonous fumes to enter the cabin.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can allow poisonous fumes to enter the cabin.
questions.explanation: A broken exhaust system lets poisonous fumes into the cab or sleeper. Check your exhaust system regularly for loose, broken, or missing parts.

questions.question: If ice forms on your side mirror while driving, it means:

options.text: Ice is probably on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice is probably on the road.
questions.explanation: If ice forms on your mirrors or windshield wipers while driving, the road surface is probably icy too.

questions.question: The only way to sober up after drinking alcohol is to:
questions.explanation: Your liver removes alcohol at a fixed rate. Cold showers and black coffee do not speed this up. You must simply wait for your body to eliminate the alcohol.

questions.question: During the driving test, when asked to make a turn, you should:

options.text: Not use a turn signal since you were told to turn.
Check traffic only on your right.

questions.explanation: When asked to make a turn during the driving test, check traffic in all directions and use your turn signal.

questions.question: Rough acceleration while driving is:
questions.explanation: Speed up smoothly and gradually. Rough acceleration makes your vehicle jerk and can damage the engine.

questions.question: When are most people least alert?
questions.explanation: Most drivers are least alert at night, especially after midnight. Fatigue-related crashes happen more often at night than at any other time.

questions.question: When backing up, you should:

options.text: Back up quickly to get out of other drivers' way.

questions.explanation: Backing up is always dangerous because you cannot see everything behind your vehicle. Use a helper to watch your blind spots whenever you can.

questions.question: If you are not sure your vehicle fits under a bridge or sign, you should:
questions.explanation: If you are unsure your vehicle will fit, slow down and find a different route if possible.

questions.question: When passengers have carry-on baggage, it is best to:

options.text: Place items in front of the rear exit door.
Leave items near the front door.
Secure items so all exits are easy to reach.

questions.correctAnswerText: Secure items so all exits are easy to reach.
questions.explanation: Baggage must not block any doorway or aisle. It must be secured to prevent damage, allow the driver to move freely, let riders exit quickly in emergencies, and protect riders from injury.

questions.question: If involved in an accident, which action is not recommended?

options.text: Moving your vehicle to the side of the road

questions.explanation: After an accident, protect the area, call authorities, help the injured, gather information, and report it. You can lose your license for leaving an accident scene.

questions.question: Why are ice cream trucks hazardous to other drivers?

options.text: Ice cream trucks need to stay cold.
Children run toward them without checking for traffic.
Ice cream trucks leave water and ice on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Children run toward them without checking for traffic.
questions.explanation: Ice cream trucks attract children who often do not notice other vehicles and run into traffic without looking.

questions.question: An exhaust system should be:
questions.explanation: Check that exhaust system parts are not loose, broken, or missing. All parts must be properly mounted and should not rub against moving vehicle parts.

questions.question: When inspecting the fifth wheel gap, you should:

options.text: Make sure the locking jaws are open.
Make sure the locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.
Make sure the locking jaws are loose.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the locking jaws are fully closed around the kingpin.
questions.explanation: The fifth wheel locking jaws must be fully closed around the kingpin shaft, not around the kingpin head.

questions.question: The tire tread depth for non-front tires on a commercial vehicle should be at least ____ in every major groove.
questions.explanation: Front tires need 4/32 of an inch tread depth. Other tires need 2/32 of an inch tread depth for safe operation.
